title: Ashita no Joe: Fighting for Tomorrow
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Joe Yabuki, a drifter in Tokyo's San'ya slums, is taken up by alcoholic ex-trainer Danpei Tange and learns boxing, partly in juvenile detention, where he meets his rival Rikiishi. Rikiishi dies after their pro bout, and Joe struggles back to fight world champion José Mendoza, ending slumped in his corner, smiling, after fifteen rounds.
life_message: It holds up burning oneself out completely for a passion, as the poor man's answer to a rigged world.
